correctness.rationale: Explicit UT4 multiplication gives the Engel coordinate aBC−2bAC+cAB. For a fixed second first-superdiagonal triple, the corresponding linear functional has fibers q^3 or q^2 according as its coefficient vector vanishes, yielding (1). In characteristic three, X^3=I iff abc=0; partitioning the second triple into support sizes 0/1, 2, 3 and applying inclusion-exclusion gives the exact joint fibers (2). The two distributions normalize, subtract to conditional uniformity, and factor to the strictly positive covariance (4). A self-contained finite-field group implementation checks 931748 coordinate pairs and 565537 direct group-operation pairs, including all F2 and F3 group pairs. Arbitrary-q validity is from the symbolic proof, not experiments.

value.rationale: The exact *joint* distribution of two distinct naturally studied group words over the canonical class-three unitriangular family supplies nontrivial dependence information unavailable from the separate word marginals. In characteristic three a striking exact conditional-uniformity phenomenon appears for all q=3^e, despite the identity events being positively correlated; the joint probability is asymptotically twice the independence prediction. These are natural whole-family invariants directly motivated by a 2026 paper on comparing these words, not arbitrary finite cutoffs.
